main.summary: Encrypts and validates confidential access key tokens with a schema-realm AES-GCM binding.

item.description: [..] : ManifestHashBytes (64 bytes, raw SHA-512 digest; all-zero bytes = no manifest hash)
[..] : TokenId (64 random bytes used as AccessKeyToken identity)
[..] : Repeated AssertionLengthSize (UInt32, big-endian) + AssertionBytes entries where each AssertionBytes payload is a serialized AccessKeyAssertion envelope
AAD = Version (1 byte) | ToolSchemaLengthSize | ToolSchemaBytes (UTF-8) | AccessKeyRealmLengthSize | AccessKeyRealmBytes (UTF-8)
Confidentiality and integrity are provided by AES-GCM with a shared 256-bit symmetric key.
The outer `v1` envelope supports both unsigned and signed tokens through explicit signature metadata fields.
Decryption is bound to the tool schema identifier and access-key realm identifier through AES-GCM associated authenticated data.
Issuer tool and access-manager identifiers, manifest hash, audiences, and scopes remain inspectable after successful decryption for policy decisions.
Guid fields use the standard .NET Guid byte layout written by .
Revocation identity is the explicit 64-byte TokenId recovered as .

method.name: TryCreateRequest
method.summary: Create an encrypted access token from a public access-key secret creation request.
method.param: Public access-key secret creation request. When the request carries a signer, a signed outer envelope is produced; otherwise an unsigned envelope is produced.
Symmetric key material. Must be 32 bytes.
Output: encrypted token bytes on success.
Output: explicit token identity stored in the encrypted payload.
method.returns: True on success; false otherwise.

method.name: TryCreateContext
method.summary: Create an encrypted access token from a normalized internal issuance context, optionally producing a signed outer envelope when a signer is supplied.
method.param: Normalized internal issuance context containing issuer identifiers, manifest identity, subject, normalized issue options, and any generated assertions.
Symmetric key material. Must be 32 bytes.
Optional signer used to produce a signed outer envelope. Null produces an unsigned envelope.
Output: encrypted token bytes on success.
Output: explicit token identity stored in the encrypted payload.
method.returns: True on success; false otherwise.

method.name: TryReadAssertions
method.summary: Decrypts, validates, and projects full embedded access-key assertions using schema-realm AAD inputs.
method.param: Symmetric key material. Must be 32 bytes.
Tool schema identifier used to rebuild the AAD.
Access-key realm identifier used to rebuild the AAD.
method.returns: True if decrypted and validated successfully; false otherwise.

method.name: IsSigned
method.summary: Determine whether a serialized access-key envelope carries outer signature metadata.
method.returns: True when the envelope is well-formed and carries a signature block; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadSignature
method.summary: Read the outer signature metadata from a serialized access-key envelope without performing certificate resolution or trust evaluation.
method.param: Output signature descriptor for either a signed or unsigned valid envelope.
method.returns: True when the outer envelope is well formed and the signature metadata was parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryGetMembershipToken
method.summary: Decrypts, validates, and projects the token into the internal membership-cache model.
method.param: Symmetric key material. Must be 32 bytes.
Tool schema identifier used to rebuild the AAD.
Access-key realm identifier used to rebuild the AAD.
Output: cached membership-token projection for authorization hot paths.
method.returns: True if decrypted and validated successfully; false otherwise.

method.name: TryReadClaims
method.summary: Decrypts, validates, and projects public access-key claims using schema-realm AAD inputs.
method.param: Symmetric key material. Must be 32 bytes.
Tool schema identifier used to rebuild the AAD.
Access-key realm identifier used to rebuild the AAD.
method.returns: True if decrypted and validated successfully; false otherwise.

method.name: BuildEnvelope
method.summary: Build a unified `v1` outer access-key envelope from encrypted payload bytes and optional signature metadata.
method.param: Signer key identifier bytes to embed in the outer envelope.
Signature bytes to append to the outer envelope.
method.returns: Serialized outer access-key envelope.

method.name: BuildSignedEnvelope
method.summary: Build a signed `v1` outer access-key envelope from encrypted payload bytes and explicit signer metadata.
method.param: Signer key identifier bytes to embed in the outer envelope.
Signature bytes to append to the outer envelope.
method.returns: Serialized signed outer access-key envelope.

method.name: BuildUnsignedEnvelope
method.summary: Build an unsigned `v1` outer access-key envelope from encrypted payload bytes.
method.returns: Serialized unsigned outer access-key envelope.

method.name: BuildAssociatedData
method.summary: Build the AES-GCM associated authenticated data buffer for a schema-realm token envelope.
method.returns: Associated authenticated data buffer.

method.name: DecodeManifestHash
method.summary: Convert a fixed manifest-hash field back into its hexadecimal string form.
method.param: Raw fixed-width manifest-hash bytes from the payload.
method.returns: Hexadecimal SHA-512 manifest hash, or an empty string when the field contains only zero bytes.

method.name: TryDecodeUtf8
method.summary: Validate and decode a UTF-8 payload field into a managed string.
method.returns: True when the payload contains valid UTF-8 and was decoded successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: EncodeUtf8
method.summary: Encode an optional string into UTF-8 payload bytes.
method.returns: UTF-8 encoded bytes. Null maps to an empty byte array.

method.name: NormalizeStrings
method.summary: Normalize optional string claims into a trimmed, ordinal-distinct, ordinal-sorted array.

param.name: values
param.para: Null, empty, or whitespace-only entries are removed.

method.returns: Normalized string array suitable for deterministic token serialization.

method.name: TryEncodeManifestHash
method.summary: Convert a hexadecimal SHA-512 manifest hash string into its fixed-width payload representation.
method.param: Optional hexadecimal SHA-512 manifest hash string.
Output fixed-width raw manifest-hash bytes. Empty or null input yields an all-zero field.
method.returns: True if the manifest hash was encoded successfully; false if the input is not valid hexadecimal SHA-512 data.

method.name: TryParsePayload
method.summary: Decrypt and parse an access-key secret into a normalized payload model.
method.param: Tool schema identifier used to rebuild the AAD.
Access-key realm identifier used to rebuild the AAD.
method.returns: True if decrypted and parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadSignatureBytes
method.summary: Read the raw signature-byte suffix from a serialized outer access-key envelope.
method.returns: True when the envelope was parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadSignatureBytesArray
method.summary: Array-based wrapper that copies the raw signature-byte suffix from a serialized outer access-key envelope.
method.returns: True when the envelope was parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadSignedRegion
method.summary: Read the canonical signed-region bytes from a serialized outer access-key envelope.
method.param: Output canonical signed-region bytes excluding the signature suffix.
method.returns: True when the envelope was parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadSignedRegionArray
method.summary: Array-based wrapper that copies the canonical signed-region bytes from a serialized outer access-key envelope.
method.returns: True when the envelope was parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryParseEnvelope
method.summary: Parse the unified outer access-key envelope into an internal normalized model.
method.returns: True when the outer envelope was parsed successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryValidateSigningInfo
method.summary: Validate signing metadata before building a signed outer access-key envelope.
method.param: Signing metadata supplied by the configured signer.
method.returns: True when the signing metadata is internally consistent and representable in the outer envelope; otherwise false.

method.name: HasConsistentIssuerIdentity
method.summary: Determine whether the parsed outer signer identifiers are consistent with the decrypted inner issuer identifiers.
method.returns: True when the envelope is unsigned or when the outer signer identifiers match the inner issuer identifiers; otherwise false.

method.name: TryCreateEncryptedPayload
method.summary: Create the encrypted payload components shared by unsigned and signed access-key envelope creation.
method.param: Guid identifying the issuing tool instance.
Guid identifying the issuing AccessManager instance.
Sequence of operation indices to authorize.
Optional lifetime for expiry; if null or <= 0 then the token does not expire.
Tool schema identifier serialized into the payload as UTF-8 and used in AAD.
Access-key realm identifier serialized into the payload as UTF-8 and used in AAD.
Optional full assertions to embed in the encrypted payload.
Optional hexadecimal SHA-512 manifest hash string.
Output explicit token identity stored in the encrypted payload.
method.returns: True when the encrypted payload components were created successfully; otherwise false.

method.name: TryReadAssertionBlock
method.summary: Try to read the optional embedded assertion block from a decrypted plaintext reader.
method.returns: True if the assertion block was parsed successfully; otherwise false.

field.name: AccessKeyRealmLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the access-key-realm length field (2).

field.name: AssertionCountSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the embedded assertion-count field (2).

field.name: AssertionLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of each embedded assertion payload length field (4).

field.name: AudienceCountSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the audience-count field (2).

field.name: AudienceLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of each audience length field (2).

field.name: BitsPerBlock
field.summary: Number of bits per permission block (128).

field.name: BytesPerBlock
field.summary: Number of bytes per permission block (16).

field.name: CiphertextLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer ciphertext-length field (4).

field.name: FixedPrefixBeforeSubject
field.summary: Number of bytes from the start of the plaintext up to SubjectBytes (IssuedAtUnix + NotAfterUnix + IssuerToolID + IssuerAccessManagerID + SubjectLengthSize = 50).

field.name: FlagsSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer flags field (1).

field.name: GuidSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of a Guid (16).

field.name: ManifestHashSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the fixed raw SHA-512 manifest hash field (64).

field.name: MaxOperations
field.summary: Maximum supported operation index count (MaxPermissionBlocks * BitsPerBlock = 16384).

field.name: MaxPermissionBlocks
field.summary: Maximum number of UInt128 blocks (128) allowed in the permission bitmap.

field.name: MinPlaintextLength
field.summary: Minimum possible plaintext length when subject, schema-realm metadata, permissions, audiences, and scopes are empty and the manifest hash is represented by its fixed 64-byte field.

field.name: NonceSize
field.summary: AES-GCM nonce size (12 bytes).

field.name: OuterHeaderFixedSize
field.summary: Fixed-size byte count of the outer access-key envelope header before signer key-id bytes, ciphertext, tag, and signature bytes.

field.name: PermissionBlockCountSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the permission block count field (2).

field.name: ReservedSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer reserved field (2).

field.name: ScopeCountSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the scope-count field (2).

field.name: ScopeLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of each scope length field (2).

field.name: SignedFlag
field.summary: Outer envelope flag bit indicating that signature metadata and signature bytes are present.

field.name: SignatureAlgorithmSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer signature-algorithm field (1).

field.name: SignatureLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer signature-length field (2).

field.name: SignerAccessManagerIdSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer signer access-manager identifier field (16).

field.name: SignerKeyIdFormatSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer signer key-id format field (1).

field.name: SignerKeyIdLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer signer key-id length field (2).

field.name: SignerToolIdSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the outer signer tool identifier field (16).

field.name: SubjectLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the subject length field (2).

field.name: SymmetricKeySize
field.summary: Symmetric AES key size in bytes (32).

field.name: TagSize
field.summary: AES-GCM authentication tag size in bytes (16).

field.name: TimeStampSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of a timestamp (8).

field.name: TokenIdSize
field.summary: AccessKeyToken identity size in bytes (64).

field.name: ToolSchemaLengthSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the tool-schema length field (2).

field.name: Version
field.summary: Version identifier for the symmetric token envelope (0x01).

field.name: VersionSize
field.summary: Size in bytes of the version field (1).
